changes.description: The rebuild check moves into the devtools test domain; report inputs select that domain, and all table counts and headline values have hand-counted anchors.
Quoted markers and continuation lines can produce invalid TOML; hash options and alternate package spellings remain literal strings, as shown by characterization probes.
The complete documentation stylesheet is inlined, preserving its source attribution.
Browser evidence is limited to the headless Chrome chart-name check; the marked check skips when Chrome cannot launch.
